about: Graphite India Limited manufactures and sells graphite electrodes, and carbon and graphite specialty products in India and internationally. The company operates through Graphite and Carbon, Steel, and Others segments. It offers a range of graphite electrodes with various diameter and power for AC and DC furnaces.
